explanation.question: Where does cost-of-living pressure in Malaysia come from, and how do states differ?
explanation.answer: For Johor in 2026-08, reported consumer-price change was 2.3% year on year and 0.4% month on month. This describes a representative basket, not personal bills. Income, spending weights and actual bills are still needed to explain household cost pressure; the inflation rate alone does not establish affordability. Categories with higher observed increases include Education (4%), Restaurant & Accommodation Services (3.6%), Food & Beverages (3.5%). These are category rates, not contributions to total inflation or established causes.
